q: Shannon's channel coding theorem (noisy channel coding theorem) states that for a channel with capacity C, reliable communication is possible at rate R if and only if:
exp: Capacity theorem: rates R<C are achievable (there exist codes with vanishing error probability), while for R>C, error probability→1 for any code. Capacity C = max_{p(x)} I(X;Y) is the maximum mutual information over all input distributions.
